# Google DeepMind

Google DeepMind is the merged AI research organization combining Google Brain
and DeepMind, known for landmark achievements including AlphaGo, AlphaFold,
and the Gemini family of models.

## Key Achievements

- **AlphaGo** (2016): First AI to defeat a world champion at Go
- **AlphaFold** (2020): Breakthrough in protein structure prediction
- **Gemini** (2023): Multimodal foundation model competing with GPT-4
